12.t: Working with data: ear size and climate
q: Which fox has the longest ears?
Describe the relationship between temperature and ear length.
The warmer the habitat, the longer the ears.
Explain how long ears help the fennec fox.
Big ears have a large surface area, so the fox loses heat to the air; they also help it hear prey.
Predict the ear length of a fox living at 0 °C and explain.
About 6 to 7 cm: between the arctic (4 cm) and red fox (9 cm); smaller ears lose less heat in the cold.
